description: Lines shared by every girl's dates: all of SERIFU/SERIFU.BIN (base 0x80197000; game-internals 6l), 47 of 48 strings (the centered pause 0x694 stays Japanese), plus the 21 place names in DATE.EXN (0x299DC, 21 x 33-byte records, written with "slot": 33) that the missed-meeting lines insert as {A}/{M}. Sections: 0 concert blurbs and 3 movie blurbs (06; names as in town_news.json), 1 the missed meeting (waiting, wrong place with a two- or three-way choice, stood up), 2 the impression thought after every choice (04, levels 0-4) and the two 'my lie was exposed' lines. Thoughts (04/06) get no parentheses (the game draws both) and end on an even letter count, else the pair padding shows as a space before the game's ')'. Place names carry their article ('the city zoo') because only these lines use them; 'Kirameki Park' and 'the planetarium' are odd-length and show a padding space before the option's closing bracket. Verified in DuckStation on forced dates (docs/testing.md 'SERIFU.BIN'): impression levels 0, 1 and 2 with final text, 3 and 4 before their endings were evened; the swim lie line after the Pool boast; concert blurbs 0 and 11, movie blurbs 3 and 6; being stood up (part 8); a two-option and a three-option wrong-place meeting with every option, the {A}/{M} names 'the theme park' and 'Kirameki Park', and the late arrival that follows. Checked only statically: the other blurbs, the skate lie line, the other place names, natural triggers, and other girls' dates.
